data.name: Planet Terminus
data.detailed_description:
Planet Terminus is a top-down tactical co-op raid shooter focused on deliberate combat, squad coordination, and atmospheric close-quarters encounters.

Enter hostile industrial zones alone or with your squad. Move carefully through dark buildings, abandoned rail yards, and contested facilities where enemy patrols communicate, investigate sounds, open doors, hold angles, and react dynamically to combat.

Choose your approach.

Move quietly with suppressed weapons, lasers, flashlights, and night vision — or fight loudly through coordinated firefights, grenades, and tactical pushes under pressure.

Every raid is built around tension, positioning, communication, and survival.

FEATURES

• Tactical top-down combat built for co-op
• Loud or stealth approaches — both fully supported
• Reactive enemy squads with dynamic battlefield behavior
• Atmospheric night operations with flashlights, lasers, and NVG
• Multi-floor CQB combat inside dark industrial buildings
• Inventory, equipment, looting, and weight management
• Dedicated server multiplayer support
• Shared squad coordination, revives, and extraction planning
• Grounded visual style and deliberate pacing

Planet Terminus is designed around believable pressure, readable combat, and the feeling of entering dangerous spaces together with your squad.

data.short_description: A top-down tactical co-op raid shooter focused on deliberate combat, stealth or loud approaches, reactive enemy squads, and atmospheric close-quarters operations.

content_descriptors.notes: Planet Terminus contains realistic firearm combat, blood effects, tactical violence, explosions, and depictions of hostile combat encounters in a dark post-apocalyptic setting. Players engage enemy squads using firearms, grenades, stealth takedowns, and close-quarters combat. The game includes tense military themes and atmospheric violence, but does not contain sexual content or nudity.
